## Notes

Five germ types; germs live on tiles, items, buildings, gases, and liquids; per-germ exposure thresholds; inhalation and ingestion exposure tiers; contraction chance 0.5 - 0.5 x tanh(resistance / 4); heat, chlorine, and radiation kill germs.
